macos.rationale: Factory App installers cover Intel and Apple Silicon Macs and x64/ARM64 Windows; a Linux desktop installer was not established. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Droid Computers.

windows.rationale: Factory App installers cover Intel and Apple Silicon Macs and x64/ARM64 Windows; a Linux desktop installer was not established. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Droid Computers.

linux.rationale: Current complete App downloads include native Linux x64/ARM64 installation.

web-client.rationale: app.factory.ai provides browser sessions through cloud sync and Droid Computers. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Droid Computers.

mobile-web.rationale: The Web & Mobile section describes browser access rather than a native mobile app. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Droid Computers.

ios.rationale: The complete product-surface list offers Web & Mobile with nothing to install, not native phone applications.

android.rationale: The complete product-surface list offers Web & Mobile with nothing to install, not native phone applications.

cli.rationale: Droid CLI installers cover macOS, Linux and Windows; npm and Homebrew options are listed. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Droid Computers.

local.rationale: Workstream machines may be the local computer, configured remote computers or fresh cloud machines. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Droid Computers, Factory Workstreams beta.

own-server.rationale: User-managed VPS, VMs and on-prem computers connect through the separate Remote Control feature. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Droid Computers, Factory Workstreams beta.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Droid Computers are Factory-managed persistent remote environments. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Droid Computers, Factory Workstreams beta.

parallel-runs.rationale: The orchestrator divides areas among agents working in parallel. Scope: Factory Workstreams beta.

coordinator.rationale: A lead orchestrator delegates to Droid sessions; each agent reports progress, blockers and results and can be opened directly. Mission Control coordinates agents after a user-approved mission plan. Further scoped facts are recorded in the atomic answers. Scope: Factory Missions, Factory Workstreams beta.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Factory App Automations supports cron-style recurring runs. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Software Factory.

sso.rationale: Business lists SSO and SAML/SCIM provisioning. Scope: Factory App and Droid CLI, Droid Computers, Factory Missions, Software Factory, Factory Workstreams beta.

starting-price.rationale: The current recurring Free plan is $0/month; this replaces the earlier paid-only lowest-price bracket.

worktree.rationale: Factory App creates separate Git worktree checkouts and branches.

roles.rationale: Owner, Manager and User have explicit role permissions.

pr-workflow.rationale: Workstreams track PRs created and managed by Droid agents.

review-ui.rationale: Product PR tabs expose Diff, Walkthrough and Validation.

license.rationale: Main application/service software has custom internal-use terms; an SDK license is separate.

self-hosting.rationale: Enterprise Custom Deployment runs all Factory inside the customer network, distinct from Private execution workers.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Enterprise airgap build disables Factory telemetry and, without a customer collector, all telemetry export. Connected-build parity is not claimed.

review.note: Telemetry is off only in the Enterprise airgap build, which is distributed through Sales for custom deployments. The finding itself says a connected-build opt-out is not established, so this is not a documented telemetry control for the ADE as generally offered.

laptop-independent.rationale: The machine guide explicitly says agents on managed remote computers continue after the laptop closes.

per-seat.rationale: Teams adds a team fee and per-seat price.

free-plan.rationale: Current plans explicitly support a recurring free tier, provider keys and credits metered by model/cloud compute use.

usage-based.rationale: Current plans explicitly support a recurring free tier, provider keys and credits metered by model/cloud compute use.

compute.rationale: Current plans explicitly support a recurring free tier, provider keys and credits metered by model/cloud compute use.

byok.rationale: Current plans explicitly support a recurring free tier, provider keys and credits metered by model/cloud compute use.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete plan list contains recurring paid subscriptions and no one-time ADE purchase.

one-time.rationale: The complete plan list contains recurring paid subscriptions and no one-time ADE purchase.

paid-from.rationale: Pro $20/month. Rechecked against the eligible finding on 2026-11-13: this paid offering remains distinct from no paid plan. Original source-check date retained; independent mapping review cleared for the revised definition.

byo-subscription.rationale: Free plan explicitly supports ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot native sign-in.

free-tier.rationale: Recurring $0/month Free plan; provider and own-compute costs excluded.

multiplayer.rationale: An active Slack thread/code channel accepts team members follow-up instructions into the same Factory session; channel sessions use the service account and Slack availability/permissions apply.
